final: WITH track_counts AS (SELECT TrackId, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM PlaylistTrack GROUP BY TrackId), totals AS (SELECT SUM(track_count) AS total_count FROM track_counts), shares AS (SELECT tc.TrackId, tc.track_count, 1.0 * tc.track_count / t.total_count AS share FROM track_counts AS tc JOIN totals AS t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL), mean_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(s.track_count) AS average_track_count, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - m.average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM shares AS s JOIN mean_share AS m ON m.average_share IS NOT NULL WHERE s.share > m.average_share
